credentials.description: API key, sent as `x-api-key`. Required unless `apiKey`, `authToken` or `authTokenProvider` is set in settings.
Optional base URL override. Defaults to `https://api.anthropic.com/v1`.

notes: Claude models through the Anthropic Messages API, with thinking, prompt caching, citations, Anthropic-hosted tools, message threads, files, skills and message batches. Decision, evaluation and extraction models run over Messages with structured output.
